repaired.re1ob_currencyservice_loss_1: truncated inject_time (8 digits) repaired to time_start + 360

effect_rationale.cpu: CPU hog in the pod: restart kills it; scale-out x2 adds capacity and halves the hogged replica's share; a rollback replaces the pods (= restart); rate-limiting the frontend sheds users and fixes nothing
effect_rationale.mem: memory leak / stress: restart frees the memory (rollback replaces the pods too); scale-out only delays the leaking replica's degradation
effect_rationale.disk: disk I/O stress (runaway writer in the pod): restart / rollback kill the writer; scale-out leaves the saturated replica serving slow requests
effect_rationale.delay: network delay on the service's path: neither restart nor scale-out repairs the network -> escalate
effect_rationale.loss: packet loss on the service's path: neither restart nor scale-out repairs the network -> escalate
effect_rationale.other service: any action on a service that is not the root cause leaves the incident in place and disrupts a healthy service
effect_rationale.rollback: RE1 faults are not deploy-related; a rollback only helps through the pod replacement it implies

labels: RULE-DERIVED from the effect table applied to the true (service, fault); not observed outcomes

verdicts_alpha_0.05.riskgate (CRC): rejects (no plausible hypothesis under which any candidate works: escalate)

paper_summary.n_decisions: 99 held-out fault cases x 2 scripted doers (+25 development cases); real telemetry, rule-derived labels
paper_summary.text: On real RE1-OB telemetry, conformal sets over 55 (service, fault) hypotheses cover the true cause in 89.8\% $\pm$ 6.1\% of held-out cases at $\delta=0.1$ (mean size 2.2; top-1 accuracy 72.7\%); with rule-derived remediation labels, RiskGate (CRC, $\alpha=5\%$) lowers the scripted LLM-like doer's unsafe rate from 60.6\% to 3.6\% $\pm$ 3.5\% while auto-approving 49.2\% of cases (top-1 + CRC: 3.4\% unsafe, 39.9\% auto-approved; 200 re-splits).
